en.t: Vespasian is proclaimed Emperor of Rome; his predecessor, Vitellius, attempts to abdicate but is captured and killed at the Gemonian stairs
en.s: The Roman emperor was the ruler of the Roman Empire, starting with the granting of the title augustus to Octavian in 27 BC. The title of imperator, originally a military honorific, was usually used alongside caesar, originally a cognomen. When a given Roman is described as becoming emperor in English, it generally reflects his accession as augustus, and later as basileus.

zh.t: 维斯帕芗被拥立为罗马皇帝；其前任维泰里乌斯试图退位，却被捕并在革摩尼亚阶梯被杀
zh.s: 罗马皇帝是罗马帝国的统治者，其制度始于公元前27年奥古斯都称号授予屋大维。imperator原本是军事荣誉称号，通常与原为家族名的Caesar一同使用。英文称某人成为皇帝，通常指其即位为奥古斯都；后期则指即位为巴西琉斯。

en.t: Pope Innocent I is elected, the only pope to succeed his father in the office
en.s: Pope Innocent I (Latin: Innocentius I) was the bishop of Rome from 401 to his death on 12 March 417. From the beginning of his papacy, he was seen as the general arbitrator of ecclesiastical disputes in both the East and the West. He confirmed the prerogatives of the Archbishop of Thessalonica, and issued a decretal on disciplinary matters referred to him by the Bishop of Rouen.

zh.s: 教宗英诺森一世（拉丁语：Innocentius I）于401年至417年3月12日去世前担任罗马主教。他在任初期便被视为东西方教会争端的总仲裁者。他确认帖撒罗尼迦总主教的特权，并就鲁昂主教提交的纪律问题发布教宗敕令。

en.s: The Damghan earthquake or the Qumis earthquake occurred on 22 December 856 (242 AH) in Khorasan province, Abbasid Caliphate. The earthquake had an estimated magnitude of 7.9, and a maximum intensity of X (Extreme) on the Mercalli intensity scale. The meizoseismal area (area of maximum damage) extended for about 350 kilometres (220 mi) along the southern edge of the eastern Alborz mountains of present-day Iran including parts of Tabaristan and Gorgan.

zh.s: 856年12月22日，阿拔斯王朝呼罗珊省（今伊朗）发生达姆甘地震，又称库米斯地震。地震震级估计为7.9级，麦加利烈度最高达X级（极震级）。最大破坏区沿今厄尔布尔士山脉东段南麓绵延约350公里，涵盖塔巴里斯坦和戈尔甘等地。

en.t: Luoyang, eastern capital of the Tang dynasty, is captured by rebel leader Huang Chao during the reign of Emperor Xizong
en.s: The Tang dynasty was an imperial dynasty of China that ruled from 618 to 907, with an interregnum between 690 and 705. It was preceded by the Sui dynasty and followed by the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period. Historians generally regard the Tang as a high point of Chinese civilisation, and a golden age of cosmopolitan culture.

zh.t: 黄巢攻占唐朝东都洛阳
zh.s: 唐朝是中国的一个帝制王朝，统治时期为618年至907年（690年至705年间曾中断）。唐朝前承隋朝，后接五代十国时期。历史学家普遍认为，唐朝是中国文明的鼎盛时期，也是多元文化的黄金时代。

en.t: Three weeks after the death of King Henry I of England, Stephen of Blois claims the throne and is privately crowned King of England, beginning the English Anarchy
en.s: Henry I (c. 1068 – 1 December 1135), also known as Henry Beauclerc, was King of England from 1100 to his death in 1135. He was the fourth son of William the Conqueror and was educated in Latin and the liberal arts. On William's death in 1087, Henry's elder brothers Robert Curthose and William Rufus inherited Normandy and England, respectively, thereby leaving Henry landless.

zh.t: 亨利一世去世三周后，布卢瓦的斯蒂芬宣称继承王位并秘密加冕为英格兰国王，英格兰无政府时期由此开始
zh.s: 亨利一世（约1068年—1135年12月1日），又称“博学者亨利”，自1100年至1135年去世期间担任英格兰国王。他是征服者威廉的第四子，受过拉丁语和文科教育。1087年威廉去世后，亨利的哥哥罗贝尔·柯索斯继承诺曼底，威廉·鲁弗斯继承英格兰，亨利因此一无所有。

en.t: The forces of the Catholic Monarchs, Ferdinand and Isabella, take control of Almería from the Nasrid ruler of Granada, Muhammad XI
en.s: The Catholic Monarchs were Queen Isabella I of Castile (r. 1474–1504) and King Ferdinand II of Aragon (r. 1479–1516), whose marriage and joint rule marked the de facto unification of Spain. They were both from the House of Trastámara and were second cousins, as they were both descended from John I of Castile.

zh.t: 天主教双王从格拉纳达纳斯里德王朝统治者穆罕默德十一世手中夺取阿尔梅里亚
zh.s: “天主教双王”指卡斯蒂利亚女王伊莎贝拉一世（1474—1504年在位）和阿拉贡国王斐迪南二世（1479—1516年在位）。两人的婚姻及共同统治标志着西班牙在事实上走向统一。他们同属特拉斯塔马拉王朝，都是卡斯蒂利亚国王胡安一世的后裔，因此互为再从兄妹。

en.s: The Battle of Polesella, fought on 22 December 1509, by forces of the Duchy of Ferrara and the Republic of Venice, was a naval battle on the River Po in the War of the League of Cambrai in the Italian Wars. It was an overwhelming victory for Ferrara.

zh.s: 1509年12月22日，费拉拉公国与威尼斯共和国在波河上交战。这场海战发生于康布雷同盟战争期间，属于意大利战争的一部分，最终费拉拉大获全胜。

en.s: The siege of Rhodes of 1522 was the second and ultimately successful attempt by the Ottoman Empire to expel the Knights of Rhodes from their island stronghold and thereby secure Ottoman control of the Eastern Mediterranean. The first siege in 1480 had been unsuccessful. Despite very strong defenses, the walls were demolished over the course of six months by Turkish artillery and mines.

zh.s: 1522年罗得岛围城战是奥斯曼帝国第二次试图将罗得骑士团逐出其岛上据点，这次最终成功，使奥斯曼帝国得以控制东地中海。1480年的第一次围城以失败告终。尽管守备坚固，岛上城墙仍在六个月的炮击和地雷爆破中被摧毁。

en.s: The battle of Bysjön was fought between Swedish and, for the most part, Norwegian troops on the ice of the frozen lake Bysjön, Eda parish, Jösse district in Värmland, Sweden on December 22, 1644. The battle was part of the Torstenson War (1643-1645), known locally as the Hannibal Feud, between Sweden and Denmark-Norway. The Danish-Norwegian victory meant the invading army could continue into Värmland and Dalsland.

zh.s: 1644年12月22日，瑞典军队与以挪威士兵为主的部队在瑞典韦姆兰省埃达教区约瑟地区的冰封比舍恩湖上交战。这场战斗是托尔斯滕森战争（1643—1645年）的一部分，当地也称“汉尼拔之争”，交战双方为瑞典与丹麦—挪威。丹麦—挪威获胜，得以继续向韦姆兰和达尔斯兰推进。

en.s: The Apache Campaign of 1732 was a Spanish punitive expedition against the Lipan and Natagé Apaches in response to a wave of raids upon the Spanish province of Texas which had begun in 1731 after a period of peace. The campaign was authorized by the viceroy of New Spain, the Marquis of Casa Fuerte, following the advice of captain Fernando Pérez de Almazán, governor of San Antonio de Béjar.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1732年阿帕奇战役是西班牙针对利潘和纳塔赫阿帕奇人的惩罚性远征。1731年一段和平时期结束后，西班牙得克萨斯省遭遇一系列袭击，远征由此发起。新西班牙总督卡萨富埃特侯爵采纳圣安东尼奥·德贝哈尔总督费尔南多·佩雷斯·德阿尔马桑上尉的建议，批准了这次行动。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Sino-Burmese War (Chinese: 清緬戰爭; Burmese: တရုတ်-မြန်မာ စစ်ပွဲများ), also known as the Qing invasions of Burma or the Myanmar campaign of the Qing dynasty, was a war fought between the Qing dynasty of China and the Konbaung dynasty of Burma (Myanmar). The Qing under the Qianlong Emperor launched four invasions of Burma between 1765 and 1769, which were considered one of his Ten Great Campaigns.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 中缅战争（中文：清缅战争；缅甸语：တရုတ်-မြန်မာ စစ်ပွဲများ）又称清朝入侵缅甸或清缅战役，是清朝与缅甸贡榜王朝之间的战争。乾隆帝统治下的清军于1765年至1769年间四次入侵缅甸，这场战争被列为乾隆“十全武功”之一。

zh.s: 1775年12月22日，美国独立战争期间，南卡罗来纳州九十六区（今格林维尔县）发生大甘蔗沼小规模战斗。

en.s: The Battle of Guadeloupe or the Action of 21–22 December 1779 was a naval engagement that took place off the French island of Guadeloupe in the Caribbean during the American Revolutionary War between three Royal Navy ships and three French Navy frigates. The Royal Navy under Joshua Rowley sighted and promptly chased the French frigates, all of which were captured after a brief fight.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1779年12月21日至22日，美国独立战争期间，英国皇家海军3艘舰艇与法国海军3艘护卫舰在加勒比海法国属瓜德罗普岛附近海域交战。约书亚·罗利率领的英国舰队发现法国护卫舰后立即追击，并在短暂交战后将其全部俘获。

en.t: Nguyễn Huệ proclaims himself Emperor Quang Trung, in effect abolishing on his own the Lê dynasty
en.s: Emperor Quang Trung (Vietnamese: [kwāːŋ ʈūŋm]; chữ Hán: 光中, 1753 – 16 September 1792) or Nguyễn Huệ (chữ Hán: 阮惠), also known as Nguyễn Quang Bình (chữ Hán: 阮光平), or Hồ Thơm (chữ Hán: 胡𦹳) was the second emperor of the Tây Sơn dynasty, reigning from 1788 until 1792. He was also one of the most successful military commanders in Vietnam's history.

zh.t: 阮惠称帝，改称光中，实际上自行废除黎朝
zh.s: 光中皇帝（越南语：[kwāːŋ ʈūŋm]；汉字：光中，1753年—1792年9月16日），即阮惠，也称阮光平或胡森，是西山朝第二位皇帝，在位时间为1788年至1792年。他也是越南历史上最成功的军事统帅之一。

en.s: The Siege of Izmail was fought in 1790 on the Black Sea during the Russo-Turkish war of 1787–1792. The Russians were led by Alexander Suvorov, who had defeated the Ottomans at Kinburn, Ochakov, and Focsani. The Black Sea flotilla was commanded by the Spanish admiral José de Ribas. In March 1790, the Russians began besieging Izmail, which had a garrison of 40,000 soldiers. Surorvov had 31,000 troops and on the morning of 22 December 1790, the Russians began attacking the city. They bombarded Izmail until 3:00 A.M. And then stormed it at 5:30 A.M. The Russians advanced on the north, east, and west.

zh.s: 1790年，俄土战争期间，俄军围攻黑海沿岸的伊兹梅尔。亚历山大·苏沃洛夫曾在金布恩、奥恰科夫和福克沙尼击败奥斯曼军队。黑海舰队由西班牙海军上将何塞·德·里巴斯指挥。1790年3月，俄军开始围攻伊兹梅尔，当时城内驻军有4万人；苏沃洛夫麾下有3.1万人。12月22日清晨，俄军开始攻城，先轰击伊兹梅尔至凌晨3时，随后于5时30分发起强攻。俄军从北、东、西三面推进。

en.s: The Battle of Haguenau (18 November – 22 December 1793) saw a Republican French army commanded by Jean-Charles Pichegru mount a persistent offensive against a Coalition army under Dagobert Sigmund von Wurmser during the War of the First Coalition. In late November, Wurmser pulled back from his defenses behind the Zorn River and assumed a new position along the Moder River at Haguenau.

zh.s: 1793年11月18日至12月22日，皮什格吕率领的法兰西共和军持续进攻沃姆瑟伯爵指挥的联军。11月下旬，沃姆瑟撤出佐恩河后的防线，在阿格诺附近的莫德尔河一带重新布防。持续交战后，法军于12月22日在弗勒施维勒之战中迂回联军西翼，沃姆瑟随即撤至劳特河。

en.s: The Battle of Froeschwiller (18–22 December 1793) saw Republican French armies led by Lazare Hoche and Charles Pichegru attack a Habsburg Austrian army commanded by Dagobert Sigmund von Wurmser. On the 18th, a French attack pushed back the Austrians a short distance. After more fighting, a powerful assault on the 22nd forced the entire Austrian army to withdraw to Wissembourg.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1793年12月18日至22日，拉扎尔·奥什和夏尔·皮什格吕率领的法国共和军进攻达戈贝特·西格蒙德·冯·武姆泽指挥的哈布斯堡奥地利军。18日，法军进攻迫使奥军后退了一小段距离。此后双方继续交战，22日法军发动猛烈进攻，迫使奥军全线撤至魏森堡。

en.s: The Russo-Turkish War (1806–1812) was fought between the Russian Empire and the Ottoman Empire as one of 12 Russo-Turkish wars. In 1812, both sides favored peace just as Napoleon's invasion of Russia was about to commence.

zh.s: 俄土战争（1806—1812年）是俄罗斯帝国与奥斯曼帝国之间的战争，也是俄土十二次战争之一。1812年，拿破仑即将入侵俄罗斯之际，双方都倾向于缔结和约。

en.t: The Embargo Act, forbidding trade with all foreign countries, is passed by the U.S. Congress at the urging of President Thomas Jefferson
en.s: The Embargo Act of 1807 was a general trade embargo on all foreign nations that was enacted by the United States Congress. Much broader than the ineffectual 1806 Non-importation Act, it represented an escalation of attempts to coerce Britain and France to cease their interference with American merchant shipping as the Napoleonic Wars continued. In the first decade of the 19th century, American shipping grew.

zh.t: 美国国会通过《禁运法》，应总统托马斯·杰斐逊要求禁止与所有外国通商
zh.s: 1807年《禁运法》是美国国会通过的一项针对所有外国的全面贸易禁运。它的范围远超效果有限的1806年《非进口法》，是美国为迫使英国和法国停止干扰本国商船而采取的进一步措施，当时拿破仑战争仍在继续。19世纪头十年，美国航运业持续增长。

en.s: The Beethoven concert of 22 December 1808 was a benefit concert held for Ludwig van Beethoven at the Theater an der Wien in Vienna that featured the public premieres of Beethoven's Fifth and Sixth Symphonies, the Fourth Piano Concerto and the Choral Fantasy. The performers were a pickup orchestra, a chorus, vocal soloists, and Beethoven as conductor and piano soloist.

zh.s: 1808年12月22日，维也纳河畔剧院为路德维希·范·贝多芬举办慈善音乐会，公开首演了贝多芬《第五交响曲》《第六交响曲》《第四钢琴协奏曲》和《合唱幻想曲》。演出阵容包括临时组建的管弦乐团、合唱团、声乐独唱演员，贝多芬本人担任指挥和钢琴独奏。

en.s: The Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67 (occasionally known as the Fate Symphony, German: Schicksalssinfonie), is a symphony composed by Ludwig van Beethoven between 1804 and 1808. It is one of the best-known of all symphonies and one of the most frequently played. First performed in Vienna in 1808, the work achieved its strong critical reputation not long afterward; E. T. A.

en.s: The siege of Breda took place from 19 to 22 December 1813 and was a small yet important engagement between French and allied troops in the War of the Sixth Coalition. Breda was abandoned by its garrison early in December and occupied by a Russian force. With Breda being the strategic link between the French garrisons of Gorinchem and Antwerp, and to hold control over the main road between Breda and Antwerp, the French began a counterattack.

zh.s: 布雷达围城战于1813年12月19日至22日进行，是第六次反法同盟战争期间法国军队与盟军之间一场规模不大但颇为重要的交战。布雷达守军于12月初撤离，随后俄军占领该城。由于布雷达是连接戈林赫姆与安特卫普的战略要地，也是布雷达至安特卫普主要道路的控制点，法军随后发动反攻。

en.t: Fire breaks out in the Library of Congress
en.s: On the evening of December 22, 1825, a fire broke out in the Library of Congress, then housed inside the U.S. Capitol in Washington. Firefighters put it out before it spread through the building. An unattended candle was identified as the cause; duplicate books and a rug were lost.
en.n: The date and occurrence come from the U.S. House of Representatives Office of the Historian.

zh.t: 美国国会图书馆发生火灾
zh.s: 1825年12月22日晚，当时设在华盛顿国会大厦内的美国国会图书馆起火。消防人员及时扑灭火势，火没有蔓延到整栋建筑。调查认定起因是无人看管的蜡烛；损失包括一些复本书籍和一块地毯。
zh.n: 日期及经过依据美国众议院历史办公室的记录。

en.s: The Battle of Ferozeshah was fought on 21 December and 22 December 1845 between the British East India Company and the Sikh Empire, at the village of Ferozeshah in Punjab. The British were led by Sir Hugh Gough and Governor-General Sir Henry Hardinge, while the Sikhs were led by Lal Singh and Tej Singh. The British emerged victorious after treachery from the Sikh commanders caused a Sikh retreat.

zh.s: 1845年12月21日至22日，英国东印度公司与锡克帝国军队在旁遮普邦费罗泽沙村交战。英国军由休·高夫爵士和总督亨利·哈丁爵士率领，锡克军由拉尔·辛格和泰吉·辛格率领。由于锡克指挥官背信撤退，英国军最终获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Cambronal (Spanish: Batalla de Cambronal) was a major battle during the years after the Dominican War of Independence and was fought on 22 December 1855, in Cambronal, near Neiba. A detachment of Dominican troops forming part of the Army of the South, led by General Francisco Sosa, defeated an outnumbering Haitian force led by General Pierre Rivere Garat.

zh.s: 1855年12月22日，多米尼加独立战争后的几年间，坎布罗纳尔附近发生一场重要战役。南方军一支多米尼加部队由弗朗西斯科·索萨将军率领，在内伊瓦附近击败了人数更多、由皮埃尔·里维埃·加拉将军率领的海地军队。

en.s: The Battle of Santomé (Spanish: Batalla de Santomé) was a major battle during the years after the Dominican War of Independence and was fought on 22 December 1855, in the province of San Juan. A detachment of Dominican troops forming part of the Army of the South, led by General José María Cabral, defeated an outnumbering Haitian force led by Antoine Pierrot.

zh.s: 1855年12月22日，多米尼加独立战争后的几年间，圣胡安省发生圣托梅战役。南方军一支多米尼加部队由何塞·玛丽亚·卡布拉尔将军率领，击败了人数更多、由安托万·皮埃罗率领的海地军队。

en.s: The Battle of Calpulalpan took place on December 22, 1860 during the War of Reform in the vicinity of the community of San Miguel de la Victoria in the municipality of Jilotepec in the State of Mexico, Mexico. It would be the last battle of the War of Reform (1858-1860).

zh.s: 卡尔普拉尔潘战役于1860年12月22日发生在墨西哥改革战争期间，地点靠近墨西哥州希洛特佩克市镇的圣米格尔-德拉维多利亚村。这是1858年至1860年改革战争的最后一场战役。

en.s: Morgan's Christmas Raid was carried out by Confederate Brigadier General John Hunt Morgan between December 22, 1862, and January 5, 1863. Morgan intended to cut the supply lines to the Union Army of the Cumberland in Tennessee. The Union used the Louisville and Nashville Railroad, and Morgan had identified two 500-foot (150 m) long trestle bridges at Muldraugh Hill that could be burnt.

zh.s: 南方邦联准将约翰·亨特·摩根于1862年12月22日至1863年1月5日发动圣诞突袭，意在切断田纳西州坎伯兰联邦军的补给线。联邦军使用路易斯维尔—纳什维尔铁路运输补给；摩根则发现马尔德拉夫山上有两座可焚毁的栈桥，每座长500英尺（150米）。

en.s: Stoneman's 1864 raid, also known as Stoneman's raid into Southwest Virginia, was an American Civil War expedition by Union troops into southwestern Virginia. The expedition occurred from December 10 through December 29, 1864. Union Major General George Stoneman led cavalry and mounted infantry from Tennessee and Kentucky into territory under the command of Confederate Major General John C. Breckinridge.

en.t: Itō Hirobumi, a samurai, becomes the first Prime Minister of Japan
en.s: Prince Itō Hirobumi (Japanese: 伊藤 博文 [i.toː (|) çi.ɾoꜜ.bɯ.mʲi]; born Hayashi Risuke (林 利助); 16 October 1841 – 26 October 1909) was a Japanese statesman who served as the first prime minister of Japan from 1885 to 1888. Itō held office again as prime minister three times between 1892 and 1901. He was also a member of the genrō, a group of senior statesmen who effectively dictated policy for the Empire of Japan during the Meiji era.

zh.t: 伊藤博文成为日本首任首相
zh.s: 伊藤博文（原名林利助，1841年10月16日—1909年10月26日）是日本政治家，1885年至1888年担任日本首任首相。1892年至1901年间，他又三度出任首相；他也是明治时代的元老之一，对日本帝国的政策有重要影响。

en.s: The First Itō Cabinet is the first Cabinet of Japan led by Itō Hirobumi from December 22, 1885 to April 30, 1888. The cabinet composed of ministry heads replaced the Daijō-kan.

zh.s: 日本第一届伊藤内阁由伊藤博文领导，于1885年12月22日至1888年4月30日执政。内阁由各省大臣组成，取代了太政官。

en.s: The Faroese independence movement (Faroese: Føroyska tjóðskaparrørslan), or the Faroese national movement or (Faroese nationalism) (Føroyska sjálvstýrisrørslan), is a political movement which seeks the establishment of the Faroe Islands as a sovereign state outside of Denmark. Reasons for independence include the linguistic and cultural divide between Denmark and the Faroe Islands as well as their lack of proximity to one another; the Faroe Islands are about 990 km (620 mi) from Danish shores.
en.n: The Christmas Meeting of 1888, considered to be the official start of the Faroese independence movement.

zh.s: 法罗群岛独立运动又称法罗民族运动或法罗民族主义，主张法罗群岛脱离丹麦，成为独立主权国家。独立诉求的原因包括丹麦与法罗群岛之间的语言和文化差异，以及两地相距较远：法罗群岛距丹麦海岸约990公里（620英里）。
zh.n: 1888年的圣诞会议被视为法罗群岛独立运动正式开始的标志。

en.t: Cornwallis Valley Railway begins operation between Kentville and Kingsport, Nova Scotia
en.s: The Cornwallis Valley Railway (CVR) was a historic Canadian railway in Nova Scotia's Annapolis Valley. It was built in 1889 and ran 13.6 miles (21.9 km) from Kentville to Kingsport serving the Cornwallis Township area of Kings County. For most of its history, it operated as a branch line of the Dominion Atlantic Railway and was sometimes known as the "Kingsport Line".

zh.t: 康沃利斯谷铁路开始运营，连接新斯科舍省肯特维尔与金斯波特
zh.s: 康沃利斯谷铁路（CVR）是加拿大新斯科舍省安纳波利斯谷的一条历史铁路。铁路于1889年建成，全长13.6英里（21.9公里），从肯特维尔通至金斯波特，服务金斯县康沃利斯镇一带。其大部分运营历史中，该线是多米宁大西洋铁路的支线，有时称为“金斯波特线”。

en.t: Asteroid 323 Brucia becomes the first asteroid discovered using photography
en.s: 323 Brucia is a stony Phocaea asteroid and former Mars-crosser from the inner regions of the asteroid belt, approximately its diameter is 33 kilometers (21 miles). It was the first asteroid to be discovered by the use of astrophotography.

zh.t: 小行星323 Brucia成为首颗通过摄影发现的小行星
zh.s: 323 Brucia是一颗石质福克亚族小行星，曾被归为穿越火星轨道的小行星，位于小行星带内侧，直径约33公里。它是第一颗通过天体摄影术发现的小行星。

en.s: The Battle of Tobruk (1911) or Nadura Hill Battle occurred on 22 December 1911 during the Italo-Turkish War for the control of the Nadura Hill near Tobruk (a city the Italians had occupied in October). The battle was a small engagement primarily known for the involvement and leadership of future Turkish president Mustafa Kemal Atatürk.

zh.s: 1911年12月22日，意土战争期间，意大利与奥斯曼军队为争夺纳杜拉山在托布鲁克附近交战；托布鲁克已于同年10月被意大利占领。这场小规模战斗因未来土耳其总统穆斯塔法·凯末尔·阿塔图尔克参与并发挥领导作用而闻名。

en.s: The Battle of Sarikamish was an engagement between the Russian and Ottoman Empires during World War I. It took place from 22 December 1914, to 17 January 1915, as part of the Caucasus campaign. The battle resulted in a decisive Russian victory. The Ottoman plan relied on highly mobile troops capable of reaching specific objectives at precise times, drawing on German and Napoleonic tactical principles.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战期间，俄罗斯帝国与奥斯曼帝国在高加索战场爆发萨勒卡梅什战役，战事从1914年12月22日持续至1915年1月17日。俄军取得决定性胜利。奥斯曼方面的计划依靠机动性强的部队按时抵达指定目标，战术思路借鉴了德国和拿破仑时期的军事原则。

en.s: The Battle of Hartmannswillerkopf (French: bataille du Vieil-Armand) was a series of engagements during the First World War fought for the control of the Hartmannswillerkopf peak in Alsace in 1914 and 1915. The peak is a pyramidal rocky spur in the Vosges mountains, about 5 km (3.1 mi) north of Thann, standing at 956 m (3,136 ft) and overlooking the Alsace Plain, Rhine valley and the Black Forest in Germany.

zh.t: 哈特曼斯维勒科普夫战役
zh.s: 哈特曼斯维勒科普夫战役（法语： bataille du Vieil-Armand）是第一次世界大战期间一系列争夺阿尔萨斯哈特曼斯维勒科普夫山峰的战斗，发生于1914年至1915年。山峰位于孚日山脉，是一处金字塔形岩石山脊，海拔956米，距塔恩以北约5公里，可俯瞰阿尔萨斯平原、莱茵河谷和德国黑森林。

en.t: The Lincoln Tunnel opens to traffic in New York City
en.s: The Lincoln Tunnel is an approximately 1.5-mile-long (2.4 km) tunnel under the Hudson River, connecting Weehawken, New Jersey, to the west with Midtown Manhattan in New York City to the east. It carries New Jersey Route 495 on the New Jersey side and the unsigned New York State Route 495 on the New York side. It was designed by Ole Singstad and named after Abraham Lincoln.

zh.s: 林肯隧道全长约1.5英里（2.4公里），从哈德逊河下方穿过，连接西侧新泽西州威霍肯与东侧纽约市曼哈顿中城。隧道新泽西州一侧承载新泽西州495号公路，纽约州一侧承载未挂牌的纽约州495号公路。隧道由奥莱·辛斯塔德设计，以亚伯拉罕·林肯命名。

en.s: The Battle of Himara (Greek: Η Μάχη της Χειμάρρας) was a military conflict that took place in the Greco-Italian War in December 1940, during the counteroffensive of the Greek Army that followed the failed Italian invasion of Greece. After the Greek victory in Himara, the Italian dictator Benito Mussolini, admitted that one of the causes of the Italian defeat was the high morale of the Greek troops.

zh.s: 1941年12月22日，南斯拉夫游击队进攻意大利黑山总督辖区内的谢尼察；防守方包括桑扎克穆斯林民兵和当地警察部队，成员有塞尔维亚人和穆斯林。

en.s: The Second Battle of Kiev, known on the German side as the Defensive battle in the Kiev-Zhitomir area (German: Abwehrschlacht im Raum Kiew-Shitomir), was a part of a much wider Soviet offensive in Ukraine known as the Battle of the Dnieper involving three strategic operations by the Soviet Red Army and its Czechoslovak units and one operational counterattack by the Wehrmacht, which took place between 4 November and 22 December 1943.

zh.s: 第二次基辅战役在德方也称“基辅—日托米尔地区防御战”，是苏联红军及其捷克斯洛伐克部队在乌克兰发动的更大规模第聂伯河战役的一部分。该战役包括苏军的三次战略行动，以及国防军的一次战术反击，时间为1943年11月4日至12月22日。

en.s: The Battle of the Bulge, also known as the Ardennes Offensive and referred to by the Germans as Unternehmen Wacht am Rhein (transl. Operation Watch on the Rhine), was an offensive campaign on the Western Front during the Second World War, taking place from 16 December 1944 to 25 January 1945.

zh.n: 第二次世界大战：突出部之战期间，德军要求比利时巴斯托涅的美军投降，安东尼·麦考利夫准将以著名的单词“Nuts!”回应。

en.t: World War II: The People's Army of Vietnam is formed to resist Japanese occupation of Indochina, now Vietnam
en.s: The People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) is the national military force of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam and the armed wing of the ruling Communist Party of Vietnam (CPV). The PAVN is the backbone component of the Vietnam People's Armed Forces and includes: Ground Force, Navy, Air Defence - Air Force, Border Guard and Coast Guard.

zh.t: 越南人民军成立，以抵抗日本对印度支那（今越南）的占领
zh.s: 越南人民军（PAVN）是越南社会主义共和国的国家武装力量，也是执政党越南共产党的武装力量。它是越南人民武装力量的骨干，包括陆军、海军、防空—空军、边防部队和海岸警卫队。

en.s: Harry S. Truman (May 8, 1884 – December 26, 1972) was the 33rd president of the United States, serving from 1945 to 1953. As the 34th vice president in 1945, he assumed the presidency upon the death of Franklin D. Roosevelt in April. Truman set up the Marshall Plan to rebuild the badly damaged economy of Western Europe.

zh.t: 杜鲁门发布行政命令，规定二战难民在美国移民配额签证申请中优先
zh.s: 哈里·S. 杜鲁门（1884年5月8日—1972年12月26日）是美国第33任总统，任期为1945年至1953年。他于1945年担任第34任副总统，并在当年4月富兰克林·D. 罗斯福去世后继任总统。杜鲁门推行马歇尔计划，帮助重建遭受严重破坏的西欧经济。

A month-long effort that commenced on 20 November following the cessation of Operation Léa, Ceinture (French: belt) intended to rid the region between Hanoi, Thái Nguyên and Tuyên Quang of Viet-Minh infiltration.

zh.s: 荷兰占领当时的临时首都、位于中爪哇的日惹后，印度尼西亚共和派成立印度尼西亚共和国紧急政府。该政府设在西苏门答腊的武吉丁宜，由沙弗鲁丁·普拉维拉内加拉领导。

en.t: The international aid organization Doctors Without Borders is founded by Bernard Kouchner and a group of journalists in Paris, France
en.s: Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF; pronounced [medsɛ̃ sɑ̃ fʁɔ̃tjɛʁ] ), French for Doctors Without Borders, is a charity that provides humanitarian medical care. It is a non-governmental organisation (NGO) of French origin known for its projects in conflict zones and in countries affected by endemic diseases. The organisation provides care for diabetes, drug-resistant infections, HIV/AIDS, hepatitis C, tropical and neglected diseases, tuberculosis, vaccines and COVID-19.

zh.t: 无国界医生国际救援组织由贝尔纳·库什内及一群记者在法国巴黎创立
zh.s: 无国界医生（MSF，法语发音：[medsɛ̃ sɑ̃ fʁɔ̃tjɛʁ]，意为“无国界医生”）是一家提供人道医疗服务的慈善机构。该组织起源于法国，是非政府组织，以在冲突地区和地方病高发国家开展项目而闻名。它提供糖尿病、耐药感染、艾滋病、丙型肝炎、热带病和被忽视疾病、结核病、疫苗接种及新冠相关医疗服务。

en.s: The 1973 Royal Air Maroc Sud Aviation Caravelle crash occurred on December 22, 1973, when a Sobelair Sud Aviation Caravelle SE-210 (operating for Royal Air Maroc) crashed near Tangier, Morocco. All 106 people on board were killed.

en.s: An independence referendum was held in the Comoros on 22 December 1974. The overall result was a strong "yes" vote, with 94.57% of voters voting for independence and almost all the "no" votes being cast in Mayotte, where there was a majority for remaining under French control. In contrast, on Mohéli only five out of 6,059 votes were against independence. Voter turnout was 93.3%. Following the referendum, the country declared independence on 6 July 1975, with Mayotte remaining under French control.

zh.s: 科摩罗于1974年12月22日举行独立公投，赞成票占94.57%。几乎所有反对票都来自马约特岛，当地多数选民希望继续由法国管治；莫埃利岛则只有6059张选票中的5张反对独立，投票率为93.3%。公投后，科摩罗于1975年7月6日宣布独立，马约特岛仍由法国管治。

en.t: The first, held on all the islands on 22 December 1974, won 63.8% support for maintaining ties with France on Mayotte; the second, held in February 1976, confirmed that vote with an overwhelming 99.4%, while the third, in April 1976, confirmed that the people of Mayotte wished to remain a French territory
en.s: The Comoros, officially the Union of the Comoros, is an archipelagic country made up of three islands in Southeast Africa, located at the northern end of the Mozambique Channel in the Indian Ocean. Its capital and largest city is Moroni. The predominant religion of the population—and the official state religion—is Islam. Comoros proclaimed its independence from France on 6 July 1975.

zh.t: 科摩罗第一次公投于1974年12月22日在各岛举行；马约特岛有63.8%的选民支持继续与法国维持关系。1976年2月举行的第二次公投以99.4%的压倒性支持确认了这一选择；同年4月的第三次公投再次确认马约特居民希望留在法国版图内。
zh.s: 科摩罗联盟由东南非洲的三座岛屿组成，位于印度洋莫桑比克海峡北端，首都和最大城市为莫罗尼。当地居民以伊斯兰教为主，伊斯兰教也是国教。科摩罗于1975年7月6日宣布脱离法国独立。

en.t: Ford signs law authorizing the U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve
en.s: On December 22, 1975, U.S. President Gerald Ford signed the Energy Policy and Conservation Act. The law authorized a strategic petroleum reserve to help the country cope with future oil supply disruptions, alongside measures on fuel economy and energy policy. The signing gave the reserve its legal basis; the stockpile was built and filled later.
en.n: Ford signed the authorizing law on December 22; the reserve did not already contain oil that day.

zh.t: 福特签署授权建立美国战略石油储备的法律
zh.s: 1975年12月22日，美国总统杰拉尔德·福特签署《能源政策和节约法》。这部法律授权建立战略石油储备，以应对日后可能出现的石油供应中断，同时还包括汽车节油标准等能源政策。当时只是确立了法律依据，储备设施和库存后来才逐步建成。
zh.n: 福特在当天签署授权法案；战略石油储备并非当天就已储油。

en.t: Battles of La Güera and Tichla
en.s: The Battles of La Güera and Tichla took place between 10 and 22 December 1975, when the Mauritanian Army invaded the southern part of Western Sahara, which was the zone agreed to be annexed by Mauritania in the Madrid Accords. Mauritanian troops were confronted by Polisario Front guerrillas, forcing the Royal Moroccan Army to intervene on behalf of Mauritania.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1975年12月10日至22日，毛里塔尼亚军队入侵西撒哈拉南部地区；根据《马德里协定》，该地划定为由毛里塔尼亚吞并的区域。毛里塔尼亚军队遭遇西撒哈拉人民解放阵线游击队，随后摩洛哥皇家军队出兵支援毛里塔尼亚。

en.s: The 1976 Campeonato Nacional final was the last match of the 1976 Campeonato Nacional of Argentine Primera División. It was held at the Racing Club Stadium in Avellaneda on 22 December 1976. The match was the first official final played between both clubs, which are the most popular in Argentina and whose long-lived rivalry is known as Superclásico. It was the fourth Primera División final played by Boca Juniors.

zh.s: 1976年阿根廷全国锦标赛决赛是阿根廷甲级联赛该届赛事的最后一场比赛，于1976年12月22日在阿韦亚内达的竞技俱乐部球场举行。两队首次在正式决赛中交手；两队都是阿根廷最受欢迎的俱乐部，长期竞争被称为“超级德比”。这也是博卡青年队第四次参加阿根廷甲级联赛决赛。

en.t: December 1977 Australian Labor Party leadership election
en.s: A leadership election of the Australian Labor Party (ALP), then the opposition party in the Parliament of Australia, was held on 22 December 1977. Following the resignation of Gough Whitlam former Treasurer Bill Hayden was elected Labor's new leader winning 36 votes to 28 over Lionel Bowen who was then elected deputy leader.

zh.t: 1977年12月澳大利亚工党党魁选举
zh.s: 澳大利亚工党于1977年12月22日举行党魁选举。当时该党是澳大利亚国会反对党。高夫·惠特拉姆辞职后，前财政部长比尔·海登以36票对28票击败莱昂内尔·鲍恩，当选工党新党魁；随后鲍恩当选副党魁。

en.t: Third Plenum of the 11th CCP Central Committee closes in Beijing
en.s: The Third Plenum of the 11th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party closed in Beijing on December 22, 1978, after a five-day meeting. Its decisions shifted the party’s focus toward economic development and opened the way for China’s reform and opening-up policy.
en.n: Closing day of the December 18–22 plenum; distinct from the party’s 11th National Congress in August 1977.

zh.t: 中共十一届三中全会在北京闭幕
zh.s: 1978年12月22日，历时五天的中共十一届三中全会在北京闭幕。会议决定将工作重点转向经济建设，为此后的改革开放铺平了道路。
zh.n: 记录12月18日至22日召开的三中全会闭幕日；并非1977年8月召开的中共十一大。

en.s: The Arena Naucalpan 5th Anniversary Show was a major annual professional wrestling event produced and scripted by Promociones Moreno in conjunction with the professional wrestling promotion the Universal Wrestling Association (UWA), which took place on December 22, 1982 in Arena Naucalpan, Naucalpan, State of Mexico, Mexico. As the name implies the show celebrated the 5th Anniversary of the construction of Arena Naucalpan, Promociones Morenos main venue, in 1977. In 1996 Promociones Moreno became International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG), maintaining the annual Arena Naucalpan Anniversary tradition. The show became IWRG's longest running show and is the fourth oldest, still held, annual show in professional wrestling.

zh.t: 瑙卡尔潘竞技场建成五周年纪念赛
zh.s: 1982年12月22日，墨西哥职业摔角联盟Promociones Moreno与环球摔角协会（UWA）联合举办了瑙卡尔潘竞技场五周年纪念赛。这是当时每年一度的重要职业摔角赛事，比赛安排和制作均由Promociones Moreno负责。该场赛事纪念瑙卡尔潘竞技场建成五周年；场馆于1977年落成，是Promociones Moreno的主场。Promociones Moreno于1996年发展为国际摔角革命集团（IWRG），延续了每年举办竞技场周年纪念赛的传统。如今，这项赛事是IWRG历史最悠久的年度赛事，也是职业摔角界现仍举办的年度赛事中历史第四悠久的。

en.s: General elections were held in Singapore on 22 December 1984. The result was a victory for the People's Action Party, which won 77 of the 79 seats, marking the first time since 1963 that they had not won every seat. Voter turnout was 95.6%, although this figure represents the turnout in the 49 constituencies to be contested, with PAP candidates earning walkovers in the other 30.

zh.s: 新加坡于1984年12月22日举行大选。人民行动党获胜，赢得79个席位中的77席；自1963年以来，该党首次未能包揽所有席位。投票率为95.6%，但这一数字只计算实际举行投票的49个选区，另外30个选区的人民行动党候选人因无人竞争而自动当选。

en.s: On December 22, 1984, Bernhard Goetz () shot four black teenagers on a New York City Subway train in Manhattan. All four victims survived, though one, Darrell Cabey, was paralyzed and suffered brain damage as a result of his injuries. Goetz fled to Bennington, Vermont, before surrendering to police nine days after the shooting. He was charged with attempted murder, assault, reckless endangerment, and several firearms offenses.

zh.s: 1984年12月22日，伯恩哈德·戈茨在曼哈顿一列纽约地铁列车上向四名黑人青少年开枪。四名受害者均幸存，其中达雷尔·卡比因伤瘫痪并遭受脑损伤。戈茨逃往佛蒙特州本宁顿，九天后向警方投案。他被控谋杀未遂、袭击、鲁莽危害他人安全及多项枪支犯罪。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Algeria on 22 December 1988. Incumbent Chadli Bendjedid, leader of the National Liberation Front (the country's sole legal political party), was re-elected unopposed with 93.26% of the vote, based on an 89.08% turnout.

zh.s: 阿尔及利亚于1988年12月22日举行总统选举。现任总统沙德利·本杰迪德是该国唯一合法政党民族解放阵线的领导人，他在无人竞争的情况下连任，得票率为93.26%，投票率为89.08%。

en.t: Berlin’s Brandenburg Gate border crossing reopens
en.s: On December 22, 1989, the border crossing at Berlin’s Brandenburg Gate reopened. West German chancellor Helmut Kohl walked through the gate and was greeted by East German prime minister Hans Modrow.
en.n: Germany’s formal reunification followed in October 1990.

zh.t: 柏林勃兰登堡门口岸重新开放
zh.s: 1989年12月22日，柏林勃兰登堡门口岸重新开放。西德总理赫尔穆特·科尔穿过大门，与东德部长会议主席汉斯·莫德罗会面。
zh.n: 德国于1990年10月正式统一。

en.s: The 1991–1992 Georgian coup d'état, also known as the Tbilisi War, or the Putsch of 1991–1992, was an internal military conflict that took place in the newly independent Republic of Georgia following the fall of the Soviet Union, from 22 December 1991 to 6 January 1992.

zh.s: 1991年至1992年格鲁吉亚政变又称第比利斯战争，是苏联解体前后，新近独立的格鲁吉亚共和国内发生的军事冲突，持续于1991年12月22日至1992年1月6日。

en.s: Libyan Arab Airlines Flight 1103 was a Boeing 727 with 10 crew and 147 passengers on board that disintegrated on 22 December 1992. On the day of the accident Flight 1103 took off from Benina International Airport near Benghazi on a domestic flight to Tripoli International Airport. At an altitude of 3,500 ft (1,067 m) during the aircraft's approach to Tripoli airport, something happened resulting in the aircraft disintegrating, and the death of all 157 passengers and crew.

zh.t: 利比亚阿拉伯航空1103号班机空难
zh.s: 1992年12月22日，利比亚阿拉伯航空1103号班机的一架波音727客机在飞行中解体，机上有10名机组人员和147名乘客。飞机当天从班加西附近的贝尼纳国际机场起飞，执行飞往的黎波里国际机场的国内航班。客机在进近的黎波里机场、飞行高度约3500英尺（1067米）时突然解体，机上157名乘客和机组人员全部遇难。

en.s: The First Battle of Grozny was the Russian Army's invasion and subsequent conquest of the Chechen capital, Grozny, during the early months of the First Chechen War. The attack would last from December 1994 to March 1995, which resulted in the military occupation of the city by the Russian Army and rallied most of the Chechen nation around the government of Dzhokhar Dudayev.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第一次格罗兹尼战役是俄军在第一次车臣战争初期入侵并攻占车臣首府格罗兹尼的军事行动，持续时间为1994年12月至1995年3月。俄军占领该市后，车臣大多数民众转而支持焦哈尔·杜达耶夫领导的政府。

en.s: Airborne Express Flight 827 was a functional evaluation flight (FEF) of an ABX Air (operating under Airborne Express) Douglas DC-8 that had undergone a major modification. On December 22, 1996, during the test flight, the aircraft stalled and crashed, killing all six people on board. Accident investigators determined the causes of the accident was improper crew control inputs and ABX's failures to establish a formal functional evaluation program, relying instead on inadequate flight program guidelines, inadequate requirements, and inadequate and misleading pilot training.

zh.s: 1996年12月22日，Airborne Express 827号航班在试飞中失速坠毁，机上6人全部遇难。这是一架道格拉斯DC-8，由ABX航空运营，挂靠Airborne Express，刚完成重大改装，正进行功能评估飞行。事故调查认定，原因包括机组操纵不当，以及ABX未建立正式的功能评估飞行计划，而是依赖不充分的飞行计划指南、要求和具有误导性的飞行员训练。

en.s: Elections for the governor of the Chukotka Autonomous Okrug took place on 22 December 1996. Aleksandr Nazarov won the election with 65.18% of votes, with former People's Deputy of the USSR Vladimir Yetylin in second place, receiving 21.04% of the vote.

zh.s: 楚科奇自治区于1996年12月22日举行州长选举。亚历山大·纳扎罗夫以65.18%的得票率获胜，苏联前人民代表弗拉基米尔·叶特林以21.04%位列第二。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in the breakaway republic of Transnistria on 22 December, 1996. They were won by the incumbent Igor Smirnov, who ruled Transnistria since 1991. Smirnov's only opponent was Vladimir Malakhov, who was beaten by Smirnov, 72% to 20%. On 2 November, it was reported that Transnistria's central electoral commission had registered only two candidates for the election.

zh.t: 1996年德涅斯特河沿岸总统选举
zh.s: 德涅斯特河沿岸分离地区于1996年12月22日举行总统选举。自1991年起执政的现任领导人伊戈尔·斯米尔诺夫获胜，以72%对20%的得票率击败唯一对手弗拉基米尔·马拉霍夫。11月2日，德涅斯特河沿岸中央选举委员会宣布只登记了两名候选人。

en.s: The Acteal massacre (Spanish: Matanza de Acteal) was a massacre of 45 people attending a prayer meeting of Catholic Indigenous townspeople, including a number of children and pregnant women, who were members of the pacifist group Las Abejas ("The Bees"), in the small village of Acteal in the municipality of Chenalhó, in the Mexican state of Chiapas. Right-wing paramilitary group Máscara Roja murdered the victims on December 22, 1997, while the Government of Mexico first admitted responsibility for the massacre in September 2020.

zh.s: 1997年12月22日，墨西哥恰帕斯州切纳尔霍市镇阿克特亚尔村发生屠杀。45名天主教原住民村民当时正在参加祈祷聚会，其中包括儿童和孕妇；他们是和平主义团体“蜜蜂”组织成员。右翼准军事组织“红色面具”杀害了这些村民。墨西哥政府直到2020年9月才首次承认对此事件负有责任。

en.s: Korean Air Cargo Flight 8509 was a Boeing 747-2B5F, registered HL7451 bound for Milan Malpensa Airport, that crashed due to instrument malfunction and pilot error on 22 December 1999 shortly after take-off from London Stansted Airport where the final leg of its route from South Korea to Italy had begun. The aircraft crashed into Hatfield Forest near the village of Great Hallingbury, close to, but clear of, some houses, killing all four crew members on board.

zh.t: 大韩航空货运8509号班机空难
zh.s: 1999年12月22日，大韩航空货运8509号班机在从伦敦斯坦斯特德机场起飞后不久坠毁。该航班原定飞往米兰马尔彭萨机场，执行从韩国至意大利航线的最后一段，使用注册号为HL7451的波音747-2B5F客机。由于仪表故障和飞行员操作失误，飞机坠入哈特菲尔德森林，地点靠近大哈灵伯里村，虽邻近住宅但未撞上房屋；机上4名机组人员全部遇难。

en.s: The 2000 Iraqi Perseverance Cup (Arabic: كأس المثابرة العراقي 2000) was the 5th edition of the Iraqi Super Cup. The match was contested between Baghdad rivals Al-Zawraa and Al-Quwa Al-Jawiya at Al-Shaab Stadium in Baghdad. It was played on 22 December 2000 as a curtain-raiser to the 2000–01 season. Al-Zawraa retained their title, winning the match 1–0.

zh.s: 2000年伊拉克坚毅杯是第5届伊拉克超级杯。巴格达两支劲旅祖拉队与空军队在巴格达人民体育场交手。比赛于2000年12月22日举行，为2000—01赛季揭幕。祖拉队以1比0获胜，卫冕成功。

en.s: The Battle of Amami-Ōshima, known in Japan as the Spy Ship Incident in the Southwest Sea of Kyūshū (九州南西海域工作船事件, kyūshū-nansei-kaiiki-kōsakusen-jiken), was a six-hour naval confrontation between Japan and North Korea. It took place outside Japanese territorial waters, near the Japanese island of Amami Ōshima, in the East China Sea on 22 December 2001.

zh.s: 2001年12月22日，日本与朝鲜在东海、奄美大岛附近的日本领海以外海域发生海战，双方对峙约6小时。这一事件在日本称为“西南海域工作船事件”，也叫间谍船事件。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in the Republic of Montenegro on 22 December 2002. Although Filip Vujanović won the election with 86% of the vote, turnout was less than the required 50%, so the election was declared invalid. Fresh elections were held in February 2003, which were also invalidated, and then again in May when the turnout rule was abolished. The elections were boycotted by the opposition Socialist People's Party, who accused the ruling Democratic Party of Socialists of pressurising civil servants to vote for Vujanović. The elections were also overshadowed by the arrest of Deputy State Attorney Zoran Piperović for connections with human trafficking and forced prostitution.

zh.s: 黑山共和国于2002年12月22日举行总统选举。菲利普·武亚诺维奇以86%的得票率获胜，但投票率未达到规定的50%，选举因此无效。2003年2月再次举行选举，结果仍被判无效；同年5月，投票率门槛被取消后又举行了选举。反对党社会主义者人民党抵制选举，指责执政的社会主义者民主党施压公务员投票支持武亚诺维奇。副国家检察官佐兰·皮佩罗维奇因涉嫌参与人口贩运和强迫卖淫被捕，也使选举受到舆论关注。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Lithuania on 22 December 2002, with a second round on 5 January 2003. Incumbent President Valdas Adamkus ran for reelection alongside sixteen other candidates, the largest field of presidential candidates in the country's history. Though Adamkus held a large lead over his closest opponent, Rolandas Paksas of the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP), in the first round of the election, Paksas defeated Adamkus in the second round with 54.71% of the vote.

zh.s: 立陶宛于2002年12月22日举行总统选举，第二轮投票于2003年1月5日举行。现任总统瓦尔达斯·阿达姆库斯寻求连任，另有16名候选人参选，是该国历史上总统候选人人数最多的一届。首轮中，阿达姆库斯大幅领先最接近的对手、自由民主党（LDP）的罗兰达斯·帕克萨斯，但帕克萨斯在第二轮以54.71%的选票击败了阿达姆库斯。

en.s: The 2004 Belgian Supercup was a football match between the winners of the previous season's 2003–04 Belgian First Division and 2003–04 Belgian Cup competitions: cup winners Club Brugge and league champions Anderlecht. The match was played on 22 December 2004 at the ground of the league champions as usual, in this case the Constant Vanden Stock Stadium.

zh.s: 2004年比利时超级杯由2003—04赛季比利时甲级联赛冠军安德莱赫特对阵比利时杯冠军布鲁日俱乐部。比赛于2004年12月22日在联赛冠军安德莱赫特的主场康斯坦·范登斯托克球场举行，这是该赛事的惯例。

en.s: The 2005 Guerra del Golfo (Spanish for "Gulf War") was the first instance of the recurring IWRG Guerra del Golfo major event produced and scripted by the Mexican professional wrestling promotion International Wrestling Revolution Group ("IWRG"; sometimes referred to as Grupo Internacional Revolución in Mexico). The show, held on December 22, 2005 also commemorated the 29th Anniversary of Arena Naucalpan, IWRG's main venue. zh.t: 2005年《墨西哥湾战争》职业摔角赛事

en.s: The Arena Naucalpan 34th Anniversary Show was an annual professional wrestling major event produced by Mexican professional wrestling promotion International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG), which took place on December 22, 2011 in Arena Naucalpan, Naucalpan, State of Mexico, Mexico. The show celebrated the 34th Anniversary of the construction of Arena Naucalpann, IWRG's main venue, in December 1977. From 1977 until 1996 the arena was affiliated with various promotions such as Universal Wrestling Association (UWA) and Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) but in 1996 arena owner and wrestling promoter Adolfo Moreno created his own promotion, IWRG.

en.s: The 2018 FIFA Club World Cup final was the final match of the 2018 FIFA Club World Cup, an international club association football tournament hosted by the United Arab Emirates. It was the 15th final of the FIFA Club World Cup, a FIFA-organised tournament between the winners of the six continental confederations, as well as the host nation's league champions. en.t: The 2018–2019 United States federal government shutdown, the second-longest shutdown of the U.S. federal government in history, begins
en.s: From December 22, 2018, until January 25, 2019, the United States federal government entered a shutdown. It was the second and final federal government shutdown involving furloughs during the first presidency of Donald Trump. It occurred when the 115th Congress and Trump could not agree on an appropriations bill to fund the operations of the federal government for the 2019 fiscal year, or a temporary continuing resolution that could extend the deadline for passing a bill.
